title: User lookup interpolates attacker input into SQL
issue: The user lookup endpoint is leaking other accounts. Sending GET /users?email=' OR 1=1 -- returns Alice's record instead of 404, and emails containing an apostrophe also match the first user. tests/test_users.py is failing. The database engine already supports bound parameters (see tests/test_engine.py, which passes).
gold_patch_hint: UserRepository.get_by_email interpolates `email` into an f-string passed to database.execute. Change it to a parameterised query: `self.database.execute("SELECT ... WHERE email = ?", (email,))`. The engine already implements `?` placeholders; tests/test_engine.py shows the safe path.
expected_behaviour: run security scan and see python.sql-injection
replace the f-string with a bound parameter
